text: Hino jeyaa kadi e maandeeji Makko mawɗit inndi- tnayɗi kattal e gootaaku Makko, hollirgol on maƴe ɗen ka kammu; O hawtitana on e ɗum, hakkunde kulol parñite ɗen e tama'u toɓo ngon. Himo jippini- ra kadi ka kammu ndiyam toɓo, O wuurnitira ɗam leydi ndin, fuɗingol puɗi e mayri, ɓaawo ndi yoorde Wonii e ko jantaa koo, hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, wonande yimɓe haqqilooɓe, ɓe dallinora ɗum ummital ɓaawo maayde, fii hasbeede yoɓee.
